items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: I got a telegram Whiteman wanted to join Fred Waring, but I declined.

ctx.x: No. No. As a matter of fact I took a couple of months off. I took my family to New Orleans. He disbanded Memorial Day of 1940. Akron, Ohio. We were playing at dog races there. And that was the end of the Whiteman band. I went to New Orleans with my
family, stayed there, and I got a telegram Whiteman wanted to join Fred Waring, but I declined. I don’t know what happened.
Well you’d had enough of that particular —
